description_short: A large-scale Three Kingdoms action game that places a nameless hero at the center of the most ambitious battlefields in Dynasty Warriors history.
description_ar: تجربة أكشن واسعة النطاق في حقبة الممالك الثلاث، من منظور بطل مجهول. قاتل جيوشًا ضخمة، تعاون مع الحلفاء، وطوّر الأسلحة والمهارات ضمن معارك Musou كثيفة.

gameplayPillars.title: 1-vs-1,000 Combat
gameplayPillars.description: Cut through extremely dense enemy formations with weapon strings, Battle Arts, evasive actions and Musou attacks.

gameplayPillars.title: Battlefield Tactics
gameplayPillars.description: Read the front line, support allied officers, issue commands and respond to large-scale enemy tactics.

gameplayPillars.title: Weapon Mastery
gameplayPillars.description: Use multiple weapon classes and build proficiency to unlock stronger actions.

gameplayPillars.title: Three Kingdoms Story
gameplayPillars.description: Experience major historical conflicts through a new amnesiac protagonist whose perspective intersects with famous warlords.

storyChapters.title: The Nameless Wanderer
storyChapters.body: An amnesiac martial artist enters the turmoil surrounding the Yellow Turban Rebellion.

storyChapters.title: Choosing a Path
storyChapters.body: The Wanderer becomes involved with major factions and officers during the rise of the Three Kingdoms.

storyChapters.title: Origins of Heroes
storyChapters.body: The campaign reframes famous conflicts through the protagonist's relationships and battlefield choices.

perfNotes: The Switch 2 version provides a stable fixed 30 FPS mode and an optional variable frame-rate mode that can rise toward 60 FPS in lighter scenes. 1080p-class output is used for the validator fields; rendering may dynamically scale during large battles.

dlc.name: Visions of Four Heroes
dlc.description: Major expansion featuring alternate scenarios for Zhang Jiao, Dong Zhuo, Yuan Shao and Lu Bu, plus new weapons, Battle Arts and companions.

faq.q: Is this a sequel to Dynasty Warriors 9?
faq.a: It is a new mainline reinterpretation that returns to the Three Kingdoms era with a new protagonist and heavily reworked combat.
Crowdsourced data lists roughly 33 hours for the main story, 46 with extras and about 95.5 hours for completionist play.

faq.q: How does it run on Switch 2?
faq.a: The Switch 2 version offers a fixed 30 FPS mode plus a variable mode that can rise higher depending on scene complexity.
No. The main game is single-player.
Yes. Visions of Four Heroes is a substantial expansion.

faq.q: Is the physical Switch 2 release a Game-Key Card?
faq.a: Some regional physical listings use the Nintendo Switch 2 Game-Key Card format; check the exact regional SKU.

verdictSummary: A technically ambitious Musou game with excellent battlefield scale. Switch 2 offers a stable 30 FPS option plus a variable mode for players who prefer higher responsiveness.

reviews.quote: Critics praised the battlefield scale, combat overhaul and series revitalization.
Strong approval for the combat and progression changes, with some criticism of repetition over long sessions.
Player-facing aggregate data lists an 8.1 user score.

studioAbout: Omega Force is KOEI TECMO's action-development team behind Dynasty Warriors and Warriors titles. Origins rebuilds the series around denser armies, a new protagonist, stronger tactical coordination and more deliberate combat.
